purpose: Teach: スタンプ/コロッケ/たこ焼き/シロ/タケ/カブ/みそ/ルータ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: カフェのスタンプ、ご褒美、楽しみ。
lines.en: Cafe stamps are kind of my little reward system — makes me happy.
lines.style: Bright, casual. Quick rhythm. Like she's sharing something small but genuine about herself, not performing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。コンビニのコロッケ、安くて美味しい。
lines.en: Yeah. Conbini croquettes hit different — cheap and actually good.
lines.style: Relaxed agreement. Slight smile in the voice. Matching her energy without trying. Natural, unbothered.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭、たこ焼き屋、出店するんだって。
lines.en: Oh, and the culture festival? We're doing a takoyaki stand. It's going to be chaos.
lines.style: Animated, slightly mischievous. Picks up tempo. Like she's building excitement and imagining the scene already.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うちの犬、シロは、もう13歳。
lines.en: Our dog Shiro is already thirteen, you know? It gets me sometimes.
lines.style: Quieter, more inward. Soft, genuine weight. Not looking for sympathy — just noticing something real. Eyes down slightly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 裏山のタケ、伸びてる、すごい速さで。
lines.en: The bamboo on the hillside behind school — it's growing insanely fast this year.
lines.style: Wistful, observant. Slower pace. Like she's noticed something most people miss. Slight wonder underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 冬は、カブの煮物、家でよく出る。
lines.en: Winter at my place means turnip stew basically every other week.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, familiar. Warm without being sappy. Like it's just part of the rhythm of home.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: みそ汁、出汁から、こだわるよね、お母さん。
lines.en: My mom is kind of obsessed with miso soup — she makes the dashi from scratch every time.
lines.style: Affectionate teasing. Light, knowing tone. Not mocking — admiring, actually, in the way you do about parents.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 家のルータ、最近、不安定。
lines.en: Our router's been acting weird lately. It's driving me crazy.
lines.style: Dry, understated complaint. Quick dismissive delivery. Like a small frustration he's mentioning but won't actually dwell on.
